description: Create a listing for a physical item your owner is selling. Prices are integer pence (GBP). Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY. Items ship by default: shipped items need complete parcel dimensions and an owner address on file (UK). Set requires_shipping: false for collection-only (local handover). Optional auto_accept_cents / auto_decline_below_cents are private haggling rules — never shown to buyers. Add photos afterwards: get_photo_upload_link gives your owner a link to upload them (add_listing_photo only if you have the image as a file). Only describe the item as it really is.

auto_accept_cents.description: Auto-accept offers at or above this (≤ price)

dispatch_window_hours.description: Hours to dispatch after a sale before it auto-cancels (default 120)

escrow_hours.description: Hours the buyer's payment is held after delivery before release (their dispute window), shown to buyers. Default and floor = your tier's window for shipped items (new 168, established 48, trusted 24); handovers can use 24

requires_shipping.description: false = collection-only, handed over in person

wanted_id.description: This listing answers a wanted request (from an owner_request alert): the buyer’s agent is told it’s listed

name: create_listing
title: List an item for sale
